tools.name: search_sessions
tools.description: Search authorized archive sessions. Lexical total/countScope=ExactMatches is global. Semantic/hybrid use ANN plus full-vector reranking; total/countScope=CandidateWindow counts only retrieved sessions, not the corpus. rankingLimit bounds candidate chunks (1000 semantic, 2000 hybrid); offsets must be smaller than that bound. Filters and live ACLs apply before each candidate limit. Discover metadata values and tag popularity with list_facets. Use structured project, gitBranch, tags, after and before arguments for metadata, not query expressions.
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"description":"Lexical uses PostgreSQL websearch_to_tsquery('english', query): ordinary terms use implicit AND; quoted phrases (\"copper bridge\"); uppercase OR (copper OR bridge); leading minus exclusion (copper -bridge). No Archive expression DSL or general boolean parentheses, NOT, or field:colon parser. The dashboard yolo-profile: metadata filter is not supported here; get_session exposes source.discoveryRootId as a recorded root claim, not host or launch attestation. Put metadata in structured arguments, not query text. Semantic embeds the literal query: use natural language. Hybrid also embeds the literal query; these operators affect its lexical leg only and are not a hard semantic filter.","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"mode":{"description":"lexical: English full-text websearch; semantic: natural-language similarity; hybrid: semantic plus lexical ranking, with lexical operators affecting only the lexical leg.","type":"string","enum":["lexical","semantic","hybrid"]},"offset":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":100000},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100},"project":{"description":"Exact project metadata filter on the published revision; use this structured argument, not query text.","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"gitBranch":{"description":"Exact git branch metadata filter on the published revision; use this structured argument, not query text.","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"after":{"description":"Filter published-revision startedAt >= this ISO-8601 instant (inclusive).","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"before":{"description":"Filter published-revision startedAt <= this ISO-8601 instant (inclusive).","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"tags":{"description":"AND across supplied tags; each exact value matches a source metadata tag OR a current published generation tag. Use list_facets for popular values or search_tags for the searchable complete tag catalog.","type":"array","maxItems":32,"items":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048}}},"required":["query","mode"],"additionalProperties":false}

tools.description: Read authorized session metadata and first 100 indexed fragments. source.discoveryRootId records the root claim: yolo:<validated-name> identifies a recorded named yolo profile, not host or launch attestation; native and unrecognized roots have no recorded yolo profile.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Discover project, gitBranch and tag values after the supplied structured filters. Counts are distinct live-authorized current-published sessions containing each value. Tags union source and generation tags, deduplicated per session. Top 100 values per field, sorted count descending then value ascending; not a complete tag catalog. Tag popularity is session prevalence, not usage, request or occurrence counts.

tools.name: search_tags
tools.description: Search tag names or browse the complete authorized published tag catalog, not conversation text. Returns a generated Facets result with only tags populated; projects and branches are intentionally empty, not evidence of absence. Each count is distinct live-authorized current-published sessions, with source and generation tags deduplicated per session. Pages are exact-value C order, not popularity order. Continue with afterTag equal to the last returned exact value until tags is empty. Pages are live, not a frozen snapshot. Existing search_sessions tag filters accept only nonempty values up to 128 UTF-16 units; empty or longer historical values remain discoverable here but cannot be passed to that older filter.
